supersedes: REFIT_HYPOTHESES_NO_CMB_RESULT_V1_SUPERSEDED.json (v1 used SupernovaIaJointLikelihood.predict returning an absolute distance modulus against residual data; SNe chi2 ~34000 was a bug, not model mismatch; fixed test-first)
authorisation: User decisions 2026-11-12: NPIPE/PR4 excluded; re-fit approved on remaining channels; then 'record input hashes' and 'add nuisance + free psi' approved. Unblinded run on those channels; NOT the CORE-07 production inference.

operator.optimizer: L-BFGS-B, 3 starts per hypothesis; all hypotheses reported success=True

inputs.excluded: CMB (Planck PR4 carrier and MC100 covariance) never loaded
inputs.provenance_note: Quasars, Radio and Gaia inputs are earlier DERIVED result files (measured count dipoles with covariance; Gaia VSH coefficients), not raw catalogues; Quasars and Radio share one JSON (same hash). SNe is the 490-object Pantheon+ residual cache; PV is the CF4 operator file (1000 of 35970 groups subsampled by stride); DESI is the DR2 BAO mean/cov text.

modes.fixed_psi: psi at fiducial (H0 67.4, Om 0.315, r_d 147.09, DeltaOmega_k 0)
modes.free_psi: H_0 in [50,90], Omega_m in [0.05,0.60], DeltaOmega_k in [-0.30,0.30] free (declared bounds); r_d fixed (BAO degenerate with H_0); SNe/PV absolute offsets analytically marginalised

caveats: SNe is now adequate under the corrected convention (chi2 ~434 for 490 points).

PV is NOT adequate: chi2 ~13745 for 1000 points at the null and it RISES slightly under H_loc (13783). The PV likelihood uses catalogue errors only (no peculiar-velocity scatter term); this is an unmodelled dispersion, not diagnosed further. Any BIC difference involving the PV block is unreliable.

The preference for H_loc comes from the Quasars and Radio count-dipole blocks (chi2 179->16 and 45->4): beta_MO absorbs an amplitude excess of the count dipoles over the model. |beta_MO| ~ 5.1e-3 is about 4x the CMB-dipole speed; no CMB channel constrains it here; this is NOT an observer-velocity estimate.
H_tilt chi2 equals the null exactly: beta_RM does not enter any enabled channel.

H_mix: chi2 gain over H_loc ~32 for 8 extra parameters, mostly in the Gaia block (58.6 -> 25.8); Delta_BIC +26.7. The fitted shear (~2-3e-3) is not a shear measurement: Gaia is a derived 11-coefficient vector with a fixed response model.

Free psi moves Omega_m to 0.293, H_0 to 68.8, DeltaOmega_k to +0.025 and lowers only the DESI block (29 -> 10); SNe is insensitive at z<0.15. These psi values are not cosmological estimates (psi is partly degenerate, bounded, r_d fixed).
Point estimates only: no uncertainties, no posterior sampling, no matched-null calibration.

claims.claim: Reproducible maximum-likelihood point estimates for four hypotheses on six real-data channels (CMB/PR4 excluded) with hashed inputs.
claims.limit: PV channel under-dispersed; derived inputs; no uncertainties

claims.claim: Departure from FLRW detected, observer velocity measured, or tilt preferred.
